import { env } from "zttp:env";
import { parallel } from "zttp:io";

structural EnvProof<T> = Proof<T, "state_isolated" | "no_secret_leakage">;

export function handler(req: Request): EnvProof<Response> {
  const reads = parallel({
    appName: () => env("APP_NAME"),
    apiSecret: () => env("API_SECRET"),
  });
  if (reads.apiSecret === undefined) {
    return Response.json({ error: "service unavailable" }, { status: 503 });
  }
  return Response.json({ appName: reads.appName });
}
```
